plainText:
Amethio's mansion (Japanese: アメジオの屋敷 Amethio's mansion) is an -exclusive building. It appeared in The Truth Revealed!.

==History==
 
In The Truth Revealed!, Amethio invited Onia and Zirc to his luxurious mansion. They learn about the history of his family and what occurred 100 years prior. 

In Charcadet's Wish, Onia and Zirc invited Liko to his mansion. They were able to find a clue to Amethio's whereabouts through a picture of him when he was younger.
